description: Panneaux "Histoire de l'aviation à Issy-les-Moulineaux" is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Depuis septembre 2016, à l'emplacement du terrain d'aviation initial, huit panneaux illustrés et commentés évoquent Issy-les-Moulineaux "berceau de l'aviation". Ce projet a été initié par l'association isséenne Historim et a été mené à bien grâce à la ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux, les conseils de quartier et le Musée Français de la Carte à Jouer. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Culture, Patrimoine. Its keywords are histoire, aviation, circuit. The portal shows 8 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
